text: Yes, the JRC map corroborates the 2023 loss. The JRC 2020 reference data confirms that 100% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020, meeting the corroboration rule. The Hansen GFC data detected a 0.7 ha loss in 2023, which aligns with the JRC baseline. However, 0.4 ha of this loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 ha, so it wasn’t counted as a full event. The remaining 0.3 ha loss was outside mapped forest areas, while 0.4 ha was in planted forest (Eucalyptus). The JRC data supports the loss observation, but the event itself was below the minimum threshold for reporting.
